name: 26.10 B2C Commerce GA - Thursday October 29, 2026
additionalInformation:
26.10 B2C Commerce GA - Thursday October 29, 2026



Salesforce B2C Commerce GA is scheduled to be deployed to Primary Instance Group (PIG).

All impacted instances will be restarted when the deployment is done.



You may review the Salesforce B2C Commerce Release Notes for this version on the Salesforce Help site under Docs > B2C Commerce Release Notes.

Links to the full year release schedule and an overview of the B2C Commerce Release policies can also be found here.





If you have any further questions, please contact your local representative or Salesforce Commerce Cloud Support via the Support Community.



Environment

Primary Instance Group (PIG)



Time: 0200 - 0700 (Local POD Time)



Impact

Typically should not exceed 15 minutes of downtime. All PIG instances will be restarted as part of the update. Active jobs and replications will be interrupted.
We make our best effort to minimize downtime through this process, however, other factors such as your customizations, data shape, size of your production realm or content of the release may also influence deployment times.

name: External IP List Update
additionalInformation: The External IP List has been updated, and the changes will take effect in 30 days. Delta changes in ip-ranges-gov-cloud.json between syncToken 1779299209 and 1792621079: us-gov-east-1 - Added 155.226.200.0/23. Important: This is a change summary relative to the first sync version mentioned above— not the complete list of IPs you should allowlist. Because updates occur as needed, always reconcile against the source of truth at https://ip-ranges.salesforce.com/ip-ranges-gov-cloud.json rather than this notice. For guidance on managing IP allowlisting, see https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=003876184&type=1

MaintenanceEvents.message:
Update: This notice was sent in error. No IP address changes will take effect on November 21, 2026.
The October 21 “External IP List Update” notice gave an incorrect 30-day effective date. No action is required by November 21.

The range in that notice, 155.226.200.0/23 (us-gov-east-1), is a valid Salesforce-owned range published at  https://ip-ranges.salesforce.com/ip-ranges-gov-cloud.json. Salesforce will begin using this IP range at a later date. We will send full details, including the effective date and preparation steps in a future communication.

Questions? Open a case via Salesforce Help with #IPChangeGovCloud in the subject.

name: MuleSoft Scheduled Maintenance
additionalInformation:
MuleSoft will be undergoing general maintenance during this time. 
 
 

Object Store v2: 

Users will be temporarily unable to create, modify, or delete partitions and key-value pairs. Viewing existing resources will continue to work. 
 


MQ: 

Users will be temporarily unable to create, modify, or delete queues, exchanges, or bindings. Viewing existing resources, message browsing, purging messages from a queue, and all client application management (create/delete/regenerate credentials) will continue to work as before. No impact to message send/receive or other MQ services. 
 


Access Management: 

During planned maintenance, customers may briefly experience a delay before recently updated access-management information is reflected. This can include changes to user access, permissions, team membership, environments, or organization settings. Normal behavior resumes after maintenance completes. 
 


API Manager: 

All management capabilities for managed and self-managed Flex Gateways will be impacted. Customers will be unable to create or start new Flex Gateways and replicas, list existing Gateways, deploy or modify APIs on existing Gateways. However, all currently running Standalone and Managed Flex Gateways and their APIs will continue to operate normally. 
 


Composer: 

The Composer domain may become completely unreachable or temporarily inaccessible. Users will be unable to access the MuleSoft Composer UI and the log in page. Existing active flow runtimes and background executions will remain unaffected and continue running normally.
